digest.component_or_area: quality gates and enforcement (lint, typecheck, complexity, Ruff)
propositions: Automated quality audit identified approved maintainability ratchets that require baseline remediation before wholesale enforcement can be enabled

Function complexity (C901), four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores), Ruff ASYNC/DTZ rules, and Ruff RUF hygiene must be staged into enforced quality gates incrementally
Pre-existing diagnostics in each ratchet family present on origin/main (including drift introduced since each story's measured baseline) must be resolved before the corresponding gate is landed
All enforced quality gate commands (make lint, make typecheck, config-check, C901 complexity check, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, Ruff RUF checks) must exit zero on current origin/main before landing
